evidence:
Source requirements are satisfied; fresh agent-image construction remains unmeasured. The actual frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx was opened with openpyxl: Quality Checks!row 16 requires an image that is pinned, pre-installs every runtime dependency, and stages assets. Internal Quality Checks!row 16 repeats that requirement; Deterministic Checks!rows 9–11 and 32 distinguish prohibited solution/tests copying, NOTE-only unpinned apt packages, image/dependency pinning, and build-only dependencies. The duplicate workbook under the frozen skill assets was also opened and has the same relevant rows. Frozen skill references/quality-checks.md:66–68 additionally requires NODE_PATH, readable assets/instructions, and an initialized empty /app.

Frozen task/environment/Dockerfile:1 is 'FROM node:22-bookworm-slim'; :3 is 'ENV NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules'; :9–12 installs 'express@5.1.0' and 'better-sqlite3@12.4.1' globally during image construction. Its entire 759 bytes equal rules/projects/webdev-task-template/environment/Dockerfile. The version-tagged base is the shipped canonical profile; no separate digest-only requirement is inferred. Apt packages at :5–7 are unversioned, which the workbook explicitly treats as a Note, not a task defect. All installed agent npm runtime dependencies are present at identical versions in task/tests/Dockerfile:16–22, with the same NODE_PATH at :9. package.json:13–19 and package-lock.json:packages[''] agree on exactly these two runtime dependencies, with TypeScript 5.9.2 and Vite 7.1.7 confined to development dependencies. server.js:2–5 imports only Node built-ins plus Express and better-sqlite3; the complete server source contains no installer invocation. This implements environment/instructions/integration.md:3,5,11 ('Starting the app mustn't install packages'). public/index.html:1–2 references shipped compiled JS and CSS; src/app.tsx:1–3 and src/runtime.ts:1 use local bundled modules. Neither build-only tool needs to be installed in the runtime image under workbook Deterministic Checks!row 32. solve.sh:25–26 only removes prior database files and copies the reference app; it does not install packages.

Dockerfile:14–16 reads 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/', and 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets'. Both COPY sources exist; the staged instruction directory contains precisely the six notes named by instruction.md:5 (behaviour, integration, overview, policy, security, ui), and assets contains seed_data.json. The seed is an empty snippets library and a scope description, not implementation. Dockerfile:17–23 creates /app, initializes/configures git, creates and commits only .gitkeep. There is no active COPY/ADD of solution/ or tests/, and no app implementation is staged there. WORKDIR /app and CMD ['sleep','infinity'] at :25–26 add no runtime install. These are source observations, not filesystem observations inside a freshly built agent container.

Raw evidence was checked independently: golden/run-golden-20260930-070504/RESULTS.json has network='none', runtime_completed=true and oracle_score_claimed=false; app.log:1 says 'Colderwater ready on port 3000', and app-restart.log:2 records pid=335 and ready=1. All 22 actual_app_files hashes in RESULTS.json match the frozen solution/app bytes. The executed drivers/launch_workflow.py:26–38 copies the solution to a temporary app directory and directly launches node with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules; :52–57 checks health and :67–74 executes the canonical restart helper. This supports startup and restart without an application-time package install in the tested runtime. The driver does not build task/environment/Dockerfile, inspect its /app, or bind its result to an agent-image build/digest. No fresh build was performed in this review, as prohibited by its assignment. Therefore the source compliance and raw application run are strong partial evidence, but they cannot honestly be presented as a measured fresh agent-image build. No confirmed source defect was found.
counterexample: Conforming false-fail witness: the actual reference supplies a compiled frontend and local bundled vendor modules while Vite/TypeScript appear only in devDependencies; demanding those build-only tools in either runtime image would falsely fail it. Confirmed read-only by package/package-lock dependency classification and bundled entrypoint inspection. Broken false-pass witnesses: an otherwise identical agent Dockerfile with NODE_PATH removed, or better-sqlite3 removed from its npm install, could still appear to pass if the existing golden run in a separately provisioned runtime were treated as proof of the agent image. In-memory source controls detected the missing NODE_PATH and reported ['better-sqlite3'] respectively; no source files or containers were changed. Similarly, the provided golden launch does not exercise the agent image's COPY, chmod, or empty-/app setup.
suggested_fix: No task-source change is established. When build execution is authorized, preserve a current-hash-bound fresh build log and resulting image identity, then inspect both module versions and resolution via NODE_PATH, read permissions for all staged notes/seed, and /app containing only its initialized git metadata and .gitkeep; retain the present golden evidence as application-runtime evidence.
